bio_text: Yun Wang (Lisa Wang) is a serial founder and XR/AI/Robotics strategist based in San Francisco, currently building at the intersection of extended reality, enterprise AI infrastructure, and industrial automation. She previously led AR enterprise strategy at Xreal and now runs RL Smart Solutions and a stealth AI startup, delivering bespoke XR, digital twin, and robotics consulting to government agencies, automotive manufacturers, and global industrial clients. Her background spans brand strategy, digital marketing, and PR, giving her a rare blend of technical depth and go-to-market experience.
